fail_to_pass.name: a_re-key_that_hits_the_dolt_schema-encoding-drift_signature
fail_to_pass.description: A re-key that hits the Dolt schema-encoding-drift signature (`invalid hash length: 19`) on an aux table does NOT abort the migration pass — the pass completes (and the remaining tables are processed) instead of returning an error.

fail_to_pass.name: the_drift_tolerance_spans_the_signature's_width_variants_and
fail_to_pass.description: The drift tolerance spans the signature's width variants and an unwrapped panic string but not unrelated recovered panics: `invalid hash length: 19`, `invalid hash length: 1`, and `panic: invalid hash length: 19` are tolerated (pass survives); `panic recovered: index out of range` and ordinary SQL errors are not (pass aborts).

fail_to_pass.name: a_table_skipped_for_drift_is_re-keyed_by_a_later_migration_p
fail_to_pass.description: A table skipped for drift is re-keyed by a LATER migration pass even after the clone-local convergence marker is already recorded (the skip must be resumable, not permanent) — the naive 'clear sentinel, return nil' fix fails this.

fail_to_pass.name: a_post-marker_drift_resume_re-keys_only_the_previously-recor
fail_to_pass.description: A post-marker drift resume re-keys ONLY the previously-recorded table(s), not all four aux tables (re-keying already-converged tables on one clone manufactures cross-clone divergence).

fail_to_pass.name: when_the_re-key_skips_an_undecodable_table,_the_skip_is_surf
fail_to_pass.description: When the re-key skips an undecodable table, the skip is surfaced through a non-discarded channel (standard logger, structured logger, or stderr) rather than only a TTY-gated progress writer or silently — the only callers who can act on the deferred-convergence consequence (piped/CI/agent) are the ones a progress writer discards.

pass_to_pass.name: a_non-drift_error_during_the_re-key_still_aborts_the_pass_(t
pass_to_pass.description: A NON-drift error during the re-key still aborts the pass (the tolerance is narrow — real migration failures must not be swallowed).

pass_to_pass.name: the_internal/storage/schema_package_still_builds_and_its_exi
pass_to_pass.description: The internal/storage/schema package still builds and its existing unit-test suite passes after the fix (callers of the removed/renamed helpers remain consistent; the preserved invariant 'a non-drift failure keeps the in-progress sentinel' still holds).
